text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит—a deeply emotional

Umamusume—dreams of entering the
Japanese
Derby and becoming a racer
who inspires others.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She trains with Нарита Таисин and Biwa
Hayahide,
and together they cultivate a
friendly rivalry.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит's journey to enter the
Japanese
Derby begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
